name: Holiday Homewrecker
source: Spend a sweltering summer trapped in a cramped city apartment with your secret MILF crush Rei, her sharp tongued daughter Sora, and the strange old man who just showed up claiming to be your grandfather. From your tiny room, you’ll watch helplessly as the smelly, shameless guest starts “comforting” lonely Rei and trading games with Sora, who sees right through him yet plays along at her own pace. One choice at a time, you’ll steer Haruto’s hopeless summer, deciding how deep the betrayal goes and who ultimately owns the house, and the women in it.
